meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化配置 Microsoft Entra 身份蓝图和令牌交换
copy.tagline_en: Automate Microsoft Entra identity blueprint provisioning and token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identities and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能指导你通过 Microsoft Graph 为 AI 代理创建和管理独立身份:创建 Blueprint、BlueprintPrincipal 和每个实例的 Agent Identity,并配置凭证、权限和 OAuth 2.0 令牌交换,提供 PowerShell 或 Python 代码。
howto.when: 当你提到“Agent Identity Blueprint”、“fmi_path”、“agent OBO”等关键词,或要求为 AI 代理配置独立身份或 OAuth 令牌交换时触发。
howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant), providing PowerShell or Python code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'Agent Identity Blueprint', 'fmi_path', 'agent OBO', or ask to set up distinct identities or OAuth token exchange for AI agents.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity Blueprint with me as sponsor.
say_en.note: Calls Graph API to create blueprint and principal.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity for my agent instance and grant User.Read.All.
say_en.note: Creates identity and assigns app role.

say_en.text: Set up fmi_path OAuth 2.0 token exchange using client_credentials.
